newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-EUROPE VS AFRICA ALL STARS TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-EUROPE VS AFRICA ALL STARS TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for the Europe vs Africa All Stars match at the Stadium of Light on Wednesday:

Europe - 20-Edwin van der Sar (Netherlands); 16-Matthias Sammer (Germany), 14-Paulinho Santos (Portugal), 11-Juergen Kohler (Germany), 4-Frank de Boer (Netherlands), 2-Zvonimir Boban (Croatia), 5-Ronald de Boer (Netherlands), 7-Vincent Guerin (France), 15-Rui Costa (Portugal), 9-Joao Pinto (Portugal), 10-Juergen Klinsmann (Germany)

Substitutes: 1-Stanislav Cherchesov (Russia), 3-Pierluigi Casiraghi (Italy), 6-Domingos de Oliveira (Portugal), 8-Stephane Henchoz (Switzerland), 12-Andreas Moeller (Germany), 13-Pavel Nedved (Czech Republic)

Africa - 20-Andre Arense (South Africa); 5-Mark Fish (South Africa), 2-Frank Awankwah (Ghana), 16-Taribo West (Nigeria), 12- Yasser Radwan (Egypt), 7-Sunday Oliseh (Nigeria), 14-Moussa Saib (Algeria), 10-Abedi Pele (Ghana), 3-Tijani Babangida (Nigeria), 9-Paulao (Angola), 8-Ahmed Ouattara (Ivory Coast)
Substitutes: 1-Abioudun Baruwa (Nigeria), 4-Chiquinho Conde (Angola), 6-Mustapha Hadji (Morocco), 11-Joaquim Quinzinho (Angola), 15-Souleymane Sane (Senegal)
Note: Players who have been substituted will be allowed to return to the pitch later in the game. This applies to a maximum of two players per team.
